target_source: EUMETSAT/OSI SAF sea-ice concentration, public source cache
conditioning_source: C3S CARRA2 sea-ice concentration reanalysis, public source cache
conditioning_alignment: Nearest CARRA2 grid point on the unit sphere to each OSI SAF crop point. Fixed geometry; ocean pixels farther than 10 km from CARRA2 excluded.
mask: Ocean/active flags and finite values in both training sources on Jan 1-6 only, intersected with fixed geographic coverage.
normalization: Physical concentration fractions already in [0,1], no data-fitted normalization. Outside-mask values zero in both sources.
checkpoint: Fixed final step with identical initial state per seed; no selection against held-out metrics.
model: Actual EncodeProcessDecode with NaiveLinearEncoder, UNetProcessor(start_out_channels=8), NaiveLinearDecoder, 32x32 latent grid, sigmoid range.
note: This is a small same-grid reanalysis hindcast/loader pilot, not real-time availability or pan-Arctic production-skill validation.
configuration_note: The first smoke call required the UNet minimum 32x32 latent grid; no training/evaluation results were produced with 16x16.
